# Modes merged: //mode:win_dev //mode:win_release //mode:linux_dev //mode:linux_release
#
# Builds with your own GCC or Clang (clang-cl too). Use as a subdirectory
# (add_subdirectory / FetchContent) and link the `fx::` targets.
#
# Targets build with the Anubis toolchain's flags, defines and link options.
# Your compiler brings its own headers, C library and C++ standard library.
# Not exported (Anubis's hermetic toolchain setup):
#   dropped: -nostdinc -nostdlib -nodefaultlibs -isysroot=./empty_dir -MD
#     -target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc its system include dirs its library dirs
#     -nostdinc++ -resource-dir=./empty_dir -target x86_64-linux-gnu
#     -D__linux__ -D__x86_64__

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(fx LANGUAGES C CXX)

# Exported for Linux Windows on x64 only; values for any other platform
# would be a guess.
set(_anubis_platforms Linux Windows)
if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME IN_LIST _anubis_platforms OR NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64|amd64|x64)$")
  if(fx_ALLOW_ANY_PLATFORM)
    message(WARNING "fx: exported for Linux Windows (x64), not ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME} (${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}); fx_ALLOW_ANY_PLATFORM is set, so building anyway.")
  else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "fx: exported for Linux Windows (x64), not ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME} (${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}). Export a mode for this platform, or set fx_ALLOW_ANY_PLATFORM to try anyway.")
  endif()
endif()

set(_anubis_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../..")

# Flags are GCC/Clang flags. clang-cl gets each behind /clang:. cl.exe takes
# different flags altogether, so it isn't supported.
set(_anubis_flag "")
foreach(_lang C CXX)
  if(CMAKE_${_lang}_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "fx: MSVC's cl.exe isn't supported; use Clang (Visual Studio: -T ClangCL).")
  endif()
  if(CMAKE_${_lang}_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    set(_anubis_${_lang}_flag "/clang:")
  else()
    set(_anubis_${_lang}_flag "")
  endif()
endforeach()
set(_anubis_flag "${_anubis_C_flag}")
foreach(_lang C CXX)
  if(NOT _anubis_${_lang}_flag STREQUAL _anubis_flag)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "fx: the C and C++ compilers must both be clang-cl or both not.")
  endif()
endforeach()

# The Anubis toolchain's settings decide optimization and debug info here, so
# CMake's per-config defaults (-O3, /Ob2, /RTC1, ...) don't apply to these
# targets. CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS still does.
foreach(_cfg DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
  foreach(_lang C CXX ASM)
    set(CMAKE_${_lang}_FLAGS_${_cfg} "")
  endforeach()
  foreach(_kind EXE SHARED MODULE)
    set(CMAKE_${_kind}_LINKER_FLAGS_${_cfg} "")
  endforeach()
endforeach()
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:MultiThreadedDebugDLL>$<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:MultiThreadedDLL>")
add_compile_options(
  "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:${_anubis_flag}-std=c++20>"
  "${_anubis_flag}-mstackrealign"
  "${_anubis_flag}-mfpmath=sse"
  "${_anubis_flag}-msse2"
  "${_anubis_flag}-msse3"
  "${_anubis_flag}-mssse3"
  "${_anubis_flag}-msse4.1"
  "${_anubis_flag}-msse4.2"
  "${_anubis_flag}-mavx"
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Windows>:${_anubis_flag}-mno-incremental-linker-compatible>"
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>:${_anubis_flag}-mlong-double-80>"
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>:${_anubis_flag}-fPIC>"
  "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:${_anubis_flag}-O0>"
  "$<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:${_anubis_flag}-O2>"
  "${_anubis_flag}-g"
  "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:${_anubis_flag}-fno-omit-frame-pointer>"
)
add_compile_options(
  "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-D_DEBUG>"
  "$<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:-DNDEBUG>"
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Windows>:-DWIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN>"
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Windows>:-DUNICODE>"
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Windows>:-D_UNICODE>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_HARDENING_MODE=_LIBCPP_HARDENING_MODE_FAST>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_ABI_VERSION=1>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_ABI_NAMESPACE=__1>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_HAS_THREADS=1>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_HAS_MONOTONIC_CLOCK=1>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_HAS_FILESYSTEM=1>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_HAS_RANDOM_DEVICE=1>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_HAS_LOCALIZATION=1>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_HAS_UNICODE=1>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_HAS_WIDE_CHARACTERS=1>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_HAS_TERMINAL=1>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_HAS_TIME_ZONE_DATABASE=1>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_HAS_MUSL_LIBC=0>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_HAS_VENDOR_AVAILABILITY_ANNOTATIONS=0>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_PSTL_BACKEND_SERIAL>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_ENABLE_CXX17_REMOVED_UNEXPECTED_FUNCTIONS>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCPP_DISABLE_VISIBILITY_ANNOTATIONS>"
  "$<$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:-D_LIBCXXABI_DISABLE_VISIBILITY_ANNOTATIONS>"
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>:-D_GNU_SOURCE>"
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>:-DSHARED>"
)
add_link_options(
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Windows>:LINKER:/DEBUG>"
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Windows>:LINKER:/Brepro>"
  "$<$<AND:$<STREQUAL:$<TARGET_PROPERTY:TYPE>,EXECUTABLE>,$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>>:LINKER:--dynamic-linker=/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2>"
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>:LINKER:--allow-shlib-undefined>"
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Linux>:LINKER:--eh-frame-hdr>"
)
link_libraries(
  "$<$<PLATFORM_ID:Windows>:oldnames>"
)

add_library(fx::clib ALIAS fx_clib)
set_target_properties(fx_clib PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "clib")
target_sources(fx_clib
  PRIVATE
    "${_anubis_root}/anubis_cmake/tests/fixtures/lang/clib.c"
)
target_compile_options(fx_clib
  PRIVATE
    "SHELL:\"${_anubis_flag}-include\" \"${_anubis_flag}${_anubis_root}/anubis_cmake/tests/fixtures/lang/sp ace/pre.h\""
  INTERFACE
    "SHELL:\"${_anubis_flag}-include\" \"${_anubis_flag}${_anubis_root}/anubis_cmake/tests/fixtures/lang/sp ace/pre.h\""
)

  "${_anubis_root}/anubis_cmake/tests/fixtures/lang/as_cpp.c"
  PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CXX)

  PRIVATE
    "SHELL:\"${_anubis_flag}-include\" \"${_anubis_flag}${_anubis_root}/anubis_cmake/tests/fixtures/lang/sp ace/pre.h\""

if(WIN32)
  add_custom_command(TARGET fx_pic POST_BUILD
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different "$<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:fx_pic>" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:fx_pic>"
    COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS)
endif()
